capabilities: render a watched source-note section into a target file using configurable rules and templates
extract fields, checkbox items, scores and frontmatter as template variables with defaults
carry over unfinished checkbox tasks into the next day's diary
insert task/completion line pairs via Enter and Shift+Enter in ruled files
create tomorrow's daily note from core Daily Notes settings
disambiguation: Not a template inserter for new notes; it continuously derives and maintains separate output files from sections of existing notes.
extras: Desktop only (atomic writes need Node fs; mobile unsupported). Manual installation from Releases is the only install method. Ships with preset diary rules that can be deleted or edited. Keyboard enhancements are optional and can be disabled in settings. Includes documented research citations for the preset diary defaults.
motivation: The author kept diary reflections mixed with daily logs; manually copying them to a separate folder was abandoned after a few days, so the derivation was automated.
problem: Obsidian notes often mix day-to-day logging with cumulative records (like reflections), and manually copying those sections to other files is unsustainable.
